messages.text: Pork allergy. Pretty uncommon — alpha-gal-related apparently. Got it from a tick bite three years ago.

Alpha-gal syndrome is a real thing and surprisingly increasing in tick-endemic areas. Affects mammalian meat broadly — beef and lamb too — though some people only react to pork. Let me know if it's pork only or any mammalian meat for you.
Just pork in my case. Lucky that way. Need a quick stir-fry tonight.

## Chicken and Cashew Stir-Fry

Fast, easy, no pork.

Slice 1 lb chicken thigh into thin strips. Marinate briefly in 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp cornstarch.

Heat oil in a wok. Sear the chicken until just cooked, remove. Add 3 cloves minced garlic, 1 inch grated ginger, 1 diced red bell pepper, and 1 cup snap peas. Stir-fry 2 minutes. Return chicken with ½ cup cashews. Drizzle in 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp brown sugar. Toss until glossy. Serve over rice with scallions.
